caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot placed centrally on a plain light-colored background. The teapot is composed of a rounded body with an olive-green color and a slightly reflective surface. The spout is elongated and curves upward toward the left. The lid of the teapot is topped with a small knob and is surrounded by a copper or reddish-brown section adorned with decorative, leafy, raised patterns. The handle arcs high above the teapot and appears metallic with a twisted design at each end, joined by a central thick black coiled section. The overall composition features mainly earthy metallic tones with no additional objects or elements in the image.
